title: Temozolomide Patient Observation – Psychometric and Biomarker Research in Oncology (Tempo-Pro)
summary:
The Tempo-Pro study focuses on patients with a newly diagnosed brain tumor during their treatment. It examines how patients feel during this period, what worries, burdens and expectations they have, and what kind of support may be helpful.

For this purpose, questionnaires, interviews, and routinely collected medical data and samples are evaluated. Participation does not change the treatment. All information is handled confidentially and analyzed without direct personal identification.

interventions.name: Single-arm, prospective, non-interventional observational study in patients undergoing temozolomide therapy. Psychometric questionnaires as well as clinical and laboratory biomarkers are assessed during the course of temozolomide treatment and prior to the first follow-up imaging.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria are adult patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma who are treated in the neuro-oncology outpatient clinic or on the neurological wards of University Hospital Frankfurt and who provide written informed consent to participate in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria are relevant cognitive impairment that affects the ability to provide valid informed consent or to participate in the study, severe difficulties understanding the German language, illiteracy, and known schizophrenia or acute delusional disorder, unless related to the current neurological disease.
